title: Bulgaria adopts the euro
note: Bulgaria becomes the 21st eurozone member.

title: EU CBAM definitive phase begins
note: EU carbon border levy starts charging importers of steel, aluminium, cement, fertiliser and other goods.

title: Ugandan general election
note: Museveni seeks another term against Bobi Wine.

title: Portuguese presidential election (first round)
note: Run-off on 8 February if no candidate wins a majority.

title: World Economic Forum, Davos
note: 19-23 January.

title: Honduran presidential inauguration
note: Nasry Asfura, declared winner of the November 2025 election, takes office.

title: US federal funding deadline
note: Stopgap funding that ended the autumn 2025 shutdown expires.

title: New START treaty expires
note: Last US-Russia strategic arms limits lapse unless both sides observe them informally.

title: Winter Olympics, Milan-Cortina
note: 6-22 February.

title: Haiti Transitional Presidential Council mandate ends
Thai general election
note: Snap election after the House was dissolved in December 2025.

title: Bangladeshi general election and referendum
note: First election since the 2024 uprising; Awami League barred.

title: Munich Security Conference
note: 13-15 February.

title: Nepali general election
note: Called after the September 2025 Gen Z protests.

title: Chilean presidential inauguration
note: José Antonio Kast, elected in December 2025, succeeds Gabriel Boric.

title: Hungarian parliamentary election
note: Orbán's Fidesz against Péter Magyar's Tisza.

title: Peruvian general election
note: Presidential run-off expected in June.

title: Beninese presidential election
note: Talon steps down.

title: Scottish Parliament and Senedd elections
note: Also English local elections.

title: Colombian presidential election (first round)
note: Run-off on 21 June if needed.

title: Ethiopian general election
note: Scheduled for June 2026; exact date provisional.

title: Armenian parliamentary election
note: A referendum on Pashinyan and the peace deal with Azerbaijan.

title: FIFA World Cup
note: 11 June - 19 July, 48 teams.

title: G7 summit, Evian
note: 14-16 June, French presidency.

title: USMCA joint review
note: Parties must decide whether to extend the agreement.

title: NATO summit, Ankara
note: 7-8 July.

title: Commonwealth Games, Glasgow
note: 23 July - 2 August.

title: BRICS summit, New Delhi
note: Indian chairship; dates fixed during 2026.

title: Asian Games, Aichi-Nagoya
note: 19 September - 4 October.

title: Russian State Duma election
note: Multi-day voting ending 20 September.

title: UN General Assembly high-level week
note: General debate of the 81st session opens in New York (approximate).

title: Brazilian general election (first round)
note: Run-off on 25 October if needed.

title: Israeli legislative election deadline
note: Election must be held by 27 October; could come earlier.

title: US midterm elections
note: All House seats and a third of the Senate.

title: COP31 climate summit, Antalya
note: Hosted by Turkey with Australia presiding over negotiations; 9-20 November.

title: G20 summit, Miami
note: US presidency; South Africa excluded by the host.

title: UN Secretary-General's term ends
note: Guterres' successor is chosen during 2026; Latin America expects its turn.
